label: What the solver computes
subgoals: State Laplace's equation with conductor potentials as boundary conditions
Integrate surface charge on each conductor
Excite one conductor at a time to fill one column per solve

label: Reading a solve
subgoals: Read the driven conductor's charge as its total capacitance
Negate each grounded conductor's charge to get a coupling
Subtract the couplings from the total to get ground capacitance

label: When the reference is golden
subgoals: Match the solver's dielectric stack to the process
Refine the mesh until the result converges
Reserve 3D solves for critical nets and calibration
